acme-data-team: hey team, we kicked off a large embeddings backfill this morning (~2M docs) and are getting a mix of 429s and occasional 'dimension mismatch' errors. job is a single worker fleet of 40 concurrent workers each sending batches of 512. errors start ~10m in and then spike. sample error: `HTTP 429 Too Many Requests` with headers `x-rate-limit-remaining: 0`, `x-rate-limit-reset: 22` and also some `400 Bad Request - embedding vector size 1536 does not match model expected 1024`. any ideas? we're throttled and the job keeps retrying which makes it worse. here's the curl we used:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"embed-universal-1024","input":["...long list of texts..."],"batch_size":512}'
```

maria (support): thanks for the report — sorry you're hitting this. couple quick q's: which model exactly (name + version) are you calling? are you using our python client or a homegrown parallel uploader? do you have retry logic (if so what backoff)? can you paste a full error payload (body + headers) for one 429 and one 400 dimension error?

acme-data-team: model is `embed-universal-1024` (we thought that matched our pipeline), but our precomputed vectors are 1536 (ugh). client is homegrown: 40 concurrent worker processes each POSTing batches of 512 IDs. retry logic is simple: immediate retry up to 3x on non-5xx. error body for 429 looks like:

```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-request-id: rwd-req-abc123
x-rate-limit-limit: 200/min
x-rate-limit-remaining: 0
x-rate-limit-reset: 18
{
  "error": "rate_limit_exceeded",
  "message": "burst quota exceeded, please back off"
}
```

and 400 dimension error:

```
HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
x-request-id: rwd-req-def456
{
  "error": "invalid_embedding",
  "message": "embedding vector size 1536 does not match model expected 1024"
}
```

kenji (sre): thanks — looking at our ingress logs for rwd-req-abc123 and surrounding requests. you're hitting the per-minute burst cap for embeddings for your org. effective limit: 200 req/min with a short burst window. with 40 workers * batch_size 512 you're spiking the request rate and also sending large payloads which amplifies load. the dimension 400s are failing quickly and your client retries instantly which creates a retry storm and pushes remaining to 0. immediate recommendations:
- stop immediate retries on 4xx (especially 400) — detect dimension error and drop or fix before retry
- add exponential backoff + jitter for 429s. example: backoff = min(10000, 200 * 2**attempt) ms + rand(0,200)
- reduce concurrency to <= 10 workers for the backfill window
- lower batch_size to 128-256 to flatten spikes

olivia (ml-infra): on the model dims: the model `embed-universal-1024` expects 1024. either:
- reproject your precomputed 1536 vectors to 1024 (not ideal), or
- switch calls to a 1536-dim model (we have `embed-1536-v2`) and that will accept your vectors, OR
- validate vector size client-side and refuse submission. sample python pre-send check:

```
# drop in your uploader
if len(vec) != expected_dim:
    # log and skip this item
    continue
```

maria (support): for repro / next steps for us to help: please share one request payload (scrubbed) and the x-request-id for a 429 and a 400. we can replay against a staging quota to reproduce throttling pattern. if you want us to expedite, we can open a infra escalation to temporarily bump your burst for a controlled backfill window while you patch the client. also, you'll want to change retry semantics: don't retry on 400, and for 429 use capped exponential backoff with jitter as kenji suggested.

acme-data-team: we can share rwd-req-abc123 and rwd-req-def456. our pipeline is old — immediate retries were added years ago. we'll patch the client today to validate dims and change retry to backoff. would appreciate temporary bump while we run the backfill.

kenji (sre): I've opened INT-7892 to track this. action items:
- temporarily increase org burst to 1500/min for 48h window (will monitor). (assigned to: kenji)
- add a short-term server-side soft-queue to smooth spikes (TBD) (kenji + olivia)
- support to replay rwd-req-abc123 in staging and confirm reproducible pattern (maria)

support-bot: escalation created INC-20260315-98 linked to INT-7892

maria (support): next steps for the customer:
- patch client: validate dims, reduce concurrency to <=10, reduce batch_size to 128-256, implement exponential backoff with jitter on 429
- send scrubbed payload + x-request-id for one 429 and one 400 to this thread
- we'll provision temporary burst bump and monitor. engineering will follow up if we see abnormal queue/backpressure

acme-data-team: thanks — we'll patch and post the ids here in the next 2 hours. appreciate the quick turnaround. :pray:

kenji (sre): noted, I'll watch metrics (ingress qps, 429 rate, dropped items). ping me if you see any 500s or if retry rate doesn't drop after patch.

maria (support): marking this as an escalation. SR# SR-34291 opened for billing/quotas team to fingerprint and approve temporary burst. we'll update when patch verified.
